Goals: comprehensive correction , focussed on alignment and space creation ul5: accept lateral open bite ur6

Dentist's Requests (e.g. delaying attachments): none 

Canine and Molar Classification - Where would you like to end up? : please distalise ul7, ul6 sequentially 1mm every 4 aligners to create space for ul5 premolar unit for restorative replacement 

AP Plane Correction: please add increased palatal root torque upper 3-3, please add ipr lower 

Final Overjet Goals (mm): 2mm

Vertical Plane Correction: please extrude 3-3 to improve overbite to 2mm

Final Overbite Goals (mm): 2mm

Transverse Plane Correction: please use ur6, ul6 as reference point and expand upper arch adding increased buccal root torque upper premolars and gingivally bevelled attachments and coordinate lower 

How to Resolve Crowding (IPR, staging of movement etc.): expand upper and procline and lower add Buccal crown torque ll3, ll4, ll5 and then ipr 

Specific Tricky Teeth Instructions: plan mesial out ur1, ul1 and distal in  and same for ll2, ll1

Any Specific Aesthetic Goals: consonant smile arc, level incisal edges lower incisors 

Avoid the Following: ipr on overlapped contacts

Additional Notes & Considerations e.g. attachment preferences, auxiliary preferences
